post.author: 0xGky
post.text:
长相相当能打的开源流量监控面板，眼下有了一个：Neko Master。

这项目做的是把网络流量摊开成一块看得见的仪表盘，谁跑得多、谁跑得少，一眼摆在那儿。

1、支持 Clash、Mihomo、Surge，多网关统一管理。

2、实时监控网络连接、流量消耗，网络活动一目了然。

3、分析流量数据，方便排查异常连接和流量消耗。

4、支持 Docker 一键部署，还能通过 Agent 采集不同设备的数据。

从前流量到底跑哪儿去了，只能翻日志一页页找；如今面板一开，谁在吃流量，扫一眼就清楚。

🔗：https://github.com/foru17/neko-master/blob/main/README.zh.md…

Neko Master

See your network traffic clearly.

> [!IMPORTANT] > **Disclaimer** > > This project is a traffic analysis and visualization tool > for local gateway environments. > > It does not provide any network access service, > proxy subscription, or cross-network connectivity. > All data is collected from the user's own network environment. > > This project is open-sourced under the MIT License. We assume no responsibility for any consequences resulting from the use of this software. Please use it in compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
## About the Name **Neko** (ねこ) means _cat_ in Japanese. Pronounced **/ˈneɪkoʊ/** (NEH-ko). Like a cat, Neko Master observes network traffic quietly and precisely. It is a lightweight analytics dashboard designed for modern gateway environments. ## 📋 Table of Contents - [✨ Features](#-features) - [🚀 Quick Start](#-quick-start) - [🤖 Agent Deployment](#-agent-deployment) - [📖 First Use](#-first-use) - [🔧 Port Conflict Resolution](#-port-conflict-resolution) - [🐳 Docker Configuration](#-docker-configuration) - [🗄️ ClickHouse (Optional)](#-clickhouse-optional) - [🌐 Reverse Proxy & Tunnel](#-reverse-proxy--tunnel) - [🔐 Authentication & Security](#-authentication--security) - [❓ FAQ](#-faq) - [🏗️ Architecture Guide](#-architecture-guide) - [🤝 Feedback & Issues](#-feedback--issues) - [📁 Project Structure](#-project-structure) - [🛠️ Tech Stack](#-tech-stack) - [📄 License](#-license) ## ✨ Features | Feature | Description | | --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | | 📊 **Real-time Monitoring** | WebSocket real-time collection with millisecond latency | | 📈 **Trend Analysis** | Multi-dimensional traffic trends: 30min / 1h / 24h | | 🌐 **Domain Analysis** | View traffic, associated IPs, and connection count per domain | | 🗺️ **IP Analysis** | ASN, geo-location, and associated domain display | | 🚀 **Proxy Statistics** | Traffic

slots.label_zh: 是否存在可部署/可运行的公开开源 GitHub 库
slots.question: Does `fact_card` name a concrete public open-source GitHub repository that can be cloned/downloaded, built or deployed, and executed directly in a sandbox?
slots.criteria_true: A specific public open-source GitHub repository with runnable code, CLI, or container deployment is identified.
slots.criteria_false: No runnable public GitHub repository exists; only news, opinion, announcement, or closed product teaser.

slots.label_zh: 是否包含可观测/可证伪结论或步骤
slots.question: Does `fact_card` state concrete steps, behavior, or performance claims that an agent can run and observe to confirm or falsify within one test session?
slots.criteria_true: Steps or behavioral/performance claims can be verified directly by running commands, benchmarks, prompts, or UI interactions.
slots.criteria_false: Claims are subjective, metaphysical, multi-month business forecasts, or impossible to observe in a technical test.

slots.criteria_true: Producing real numbers, compatibility notes, or a reproducibility report gives meaningful engineering insight.
slots.criteria_false: Trivial toy spam, engagement bait, or uninformative marketing copy with no real engineering takeaway.

slots.criteria_false: Public, free/open-source, or runs using only tools/frontier CLIs already listed in `capabilities` without new signups or payments.

slots.criteria_true: Requires hardware/OS unavailable across all listed nodes (e.g., 80GB H100, Windows-only driver, physical Android device).
slots.criteria_false: Fits comfortably within at least one node in `capabilities.available_nodes`.

slots.label_zh: 是否超过 2 小时时限或需要线下物理动作
slots.question: Would a minimal faithful verification of `fact_card` realistically take more than 120 minutes total (e.g. downloading huge >40GB datasets, multi-hour model pretraining, waiting days) or require human offline physical actions?
slots.criteria_true: Minimal verification exceeds 120 minutes or requires offline physical human intervention.
slots.criteria_false: Setup plus meaningful test verification can complete cleanly well within 120 minutes.

slots.criteria_false: Runs safely inside an ephemeral user-space container, temp dir, or clean browser sandbox without risking hardware or host stability.
